name: mcp-new-hire-finder
description: MCP server for New Hire Finder. Find the people who started a role at a company in the last few months. Give a company domain, the titles you sell to, and a lookback window. Get one flat row per person: name, profile URL, title, start month, prior role, move type (new hire or internal promotion), and the source that found them. Runs on Apify. Clay-ready output.
